William Shakespeare, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-shakespeare/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Shakespeare, the author, died 1616 (Wikidata Q692; every death date recorded for this person falls in 1616).

First publication of the text used: between 1593 and 1609 (the colophon says the poems were published in that span; the earliest is 1593) (SE colophon: 'Poetry was compiled from poems published between 1593 and 1609 by William Shakespeare.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the poems were first published between 1593 and 1609, all before 1931, so the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the text was first published in England (United Kingdom), but the country does not change the result. The last person to die did so in 1616, more than 100 years before 2026. The work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
